description: Runs a studio template and CHARGES the member's credits (failed steps are refunded). Refused if the cost is above max_credits. Image inputs take an https link to a JPEG/PNG/WebP image, "generation:<id>" of an earlier Lexu result (from list_generations), or "upload:<id>" from create_upload_link for a photo on the member's device. Returns a job id; results take one to several minutes (use get_studio_job).

inputs.description: Input values by name, as listed by get_studio_template. Select inputs take one of the option values.

max_credits.description: The most the member agreed to spend on this run (the price from get_studio_template).

wait_seconds.description: Wait this long for the result (default 30).

name: run_studio_template
title: Run studio template
